verdict.rationale: SumUp documents pairing Solo readers to a SumUp account, including multiple readers with custom names, and testing that pairing and checkout flow with Virtual Solo before switching to a physical reader. It also documents triggering payments on the paired reader from any POS via the Cloud API, and apps controlling a reader over Bluetooth. missing for 10: evidence that setup to first payment actually takes minutes, a step-by-step merchant-facing pairing walkthrough (the evidence is developer-oriented), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the pairing experience.
